issue_context.title: `gh auth login --with-token` doesn't use `GH_HOST` environment variable
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

I am trying to set `GH_HOST="myenterprise.com"` as an environment variable and use `gh auth login --with-token` to log into my enterprise server with a CI tool.  

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

```
export GH_HOST="myenterprise.com"
echo "enterprise token" | gh auth login --with-token
```

### Expected vs actual behavior

I am expecting for my authentication to be successful.

The actual behavior is I get an error implying that it tried to authenticate with github.com:

### Logs

```
error validating token: HTTP 401: Bad credentials (https://api.github.com/)
Try authenticating with:  gh auth login
```

review_comments: Weird. This was just wrong before? Nice job catching that.
